description: Use when an agent must know if a URL is up before linking, scraping or alerting. Input: url or bare domain (https:// assumed). Output: up (final status below 400), HTTP status, final URL, redirect chain, HTTPS and http-to-https upgrade, response time in ms, content type, server. Down or timed-out sites return up: false. Private targets → 400 before payment. Example: ?url=example.com Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

url.description: URL or bare domain (https:// assumed); private/internal targets → 400 (not charged)

name: web_check
title: Is this URL up? HTTP status, redirects, HTTPS and response time in one GET
